faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.aside: Still unclear on something? A human replies within 48 hours.

items.question: How does Decision Intelligence differ from traditional Business Intelligence?
items.answer: BI reports what happened; Decision Intelligence closes the loop. Our systems carry memory of prior decisions, explain why a pattern is occurring, recommend the next action, and record the outcome so the next recommendation is better than the last.

items.question: How long does it take to deploy an Enterprise AI Platform with Rebel Labz?
items.answer: A working pilot on a real decision runs 4–6 weeks from kickoff. Production hardening typically follows within a quarter — and because the platform is reusable, the second and third use cases deploy in a fraction of the time.

items.question: How do you ensure data governance and memory management across models?
items.answer: Memory before models. Every system deploys on a governed memory core inside your perimeter, with scoped agent permissions, full lineage on every read and write, and a replayable audit trail your risk team can inspect line by line.

items.question: Can Rebel Labz integrate with our existing enterprise data stack?
items.answer: Yes — we are deliberately stack-agnostic. We connect to your existing warehouse, lakehouse, and operational systems rather than replacing them, so the memory core layers on top of what you already run.
